text.tspan: – a state per TOKEN, not one operator for all

g.text: module: st(p) = A st−1(p) + Bz zt(p) + Ba at for every one of the P = 256 tokens
the predictor as built – ONE operator, broadcast over every token
the same LinearDynamicsPredictor at num_patches = 1 and at num_patches = 256
the token axis buys NO dynamics
every token is pushed forward by the SAME operator – a token's dynamics are not its own
and no state is carried at all: the memory is a 3-frame slice of the INPUT
ST2 – one state per TOKEN, carried across time
the state tensor's shape, captured at render time from a forward hook on A
params at P = 1 AND at P = 256
zt+1(p) = W ReLU( C st(p) ) , one scan of 3 steps, per token
the operator is STILL shared – what becomes per-token is the STATE
no new code: _trunk's ssm branch already carries the P axis, so ST2 is T1 with FEATURE=patch
the SAME spec as ST2's – only ARM_FEAT differs
n = 0 on the fixed instrument · in flight
ABLATION – the same tokens, no state
a NULL: the interval spans zero
st(p) = A st−1(p) + Bz zt(p) + Ba at
the FIR modes carry no state: their memory is num_hist frames of INPUT
removing either axis destroys the mechanism, which is what makes it ONE arm
